title: Texas left tackle and likely first-round pick Trevor Goosby out for season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Texas left tackle and likely first-round pick Trevor Goosby out for season
sources.description: Texas left tackle Trevor Goosby, a likely first-round draft pick and the protector of Arch Manning's blind side, will miss the rest of this season with a knee injury.
